plastic.name: Plastic
plastic.disposal: Empty and rinse recyclable plastic containers. Follow local recycling rules.

paper.name: Paper
paper.disposal: Keep paper clean and dry for recycling.
paper.safety: Avoid recycling paper contaminated with food, oil, or chemicals.

organic.name: Organic waste
organic.disposal: Place suitable food and plant waste in wet waste or compost collection.

glass.name: Glass
glass.disposal: Rinse glass and keep it with dry waste for recycling. Follow local rules.
glass.safety: Wrap broken glass securely before disposal.

electronic.name: Electronic waste
electronic.disposal: Take electronic devices to an authorized e-waste collection point.
electronic.safety: Do not dismantle electronics or put batteries in ordinary waste.

hazardous.name: Special care waste
hazardous.disposal: Hand over only to an authorised agency or a designated collection centre.
hazardous.safety: Avoid direct contact and keep hazardous materials away from children.

general.name: Dry waste (non-recyclable)
general.disposal: Not recyclable. Keep it with dry waste, and wrap sharp or soiled items first.
general.safety: Check whether the item contains batteries, bulbs, medicines or chemicals; those are special care waste.

sanitary.name: Sanitary waste
sanitary.disposal: Wrap securely and keep it separate from wet and dry waste until collection.
sanitary.safety: Never flush. Keep away from children and animals.

aluminium_can.name: Aluminium can
aluminium_can.disposal: Rinse or wipe off food, keep it dry and give it to the dry-waste collector or a local scrap dealer.

metal_food_can.name: Metal food can
metal_food_can.disposal: Rinse, remove paper label if you can, and flatten if safe.

light_bulb.name: Incandescent / halogen bulb
light_bulb.disposal: Ordinary filament/halogen bulbs are not recyclable. Wrap in paper so the glass does not break and put in dry waste. CFL and tube lights are different: see CFL bulb and tube light.

medicine.name: Expired medicine
medicine.disposal: Do not flush or throw loose. Return to the pharmacy or a drug take-back point; otherwise mix with sawdust or coffee grounds in a sealed bag.
medicine.safety: Keep out of reach of children and animals.

ceramic_mug.name: Ceramic mug
ceramic_mug.disposal: Mirrors, window glass, cookware glass, ceramics and tiles melt at different temperatures from bottle glass and are not accepted with it. Wrap securely and put in dry waste.
ceramic_mug.safety: Wrap sharp pieces in newspaper and label them before disposal.

cooking_oil.name: Used cooking oil
cooking_oil.disposal: Never pour used oil down the drain. Let it cool, store it in a sealed container and hand it to a used-cooking-oil collector (e.g. FSSAI RUCO scheme) if available; otherwise absorb in a cloth or paper and put in dry waste.
cooking_oil.safety: Hot oil can cause burns; do not mix with other liquids.

nail_polish.name: Nail polish
nail_polish.disposal: Dry out leftovers or hand to special care waste.

hair_dye.name: Hair dye packaging
hair_dye.disposal: Use up. Leftover mix is special care waste; empty tubes go to dry waste.

wet_wipes.name: Used wet wipes
wet_wipes.disposal: Never flush. Put in dry waste.

sanitary_pad.name: Used sanitary pad
sanitary_pad.disposal: Wrap in paper or the pad's own wrapper and keep it with sanitary waste.

power_bank.name: Power bank
power_bank.disposal: Contains a lithium battery. Hand it to an authorised e-waste collector or a battery take-back point.
power_bank.safety: Never put it in ordinary waste or crush it; swollen batteries can catch fire.

printer_cartridge.name: Printer cartridge
printer_cartridge.disposal: Return to the manufacturer's take-back or an authorised recycler.
printer_cartridge.safety: Avoid skin contact with leftover ink.

circuit_board.name: Circuit board
circuit_board.disposal: Take it to an authorised e-waste collection point or return it to the brand/retailer take-back scheme.

broken_mirror.name: Broken mirror
broken_mirror.disposal: Mirrors, window glass, cookware glass, ceramics and tiles melt at different temperatures from bottle glass and are not accepted with it. Wrap securely and put in dry waste.
broken_mirror.safety: Wrap sharp pieces in newspaper and label them before disposal.

broken_plate.name: Broken ceramic plate
broken_plate.disposal: Mirrors, window glass, cookware glass, ceramics and tiles melt at different temperatures from bottle glass and are not accepted with it. Wrap securely and put in dry waste.
broken_plate.safety: Wrap sharp pieces in newspaper and label them before disposal.

pesticide_container.name: Pesticide container
pesticide_container.disposal: Triple-rinse if possible and hand to special care waste or agri-collection points.
pesticide_container.safety: Do not reuse for food or water.

toothbrush.name: Toothbrush
toothbrush.disposal: Put in dry waste (bamboo handles can be removed and composted).

paper_pizza_box.name: Paper pizza box
paper_pizza_box.disposal: Clean, dry cardboard is recyclable. Greasy or food-stained parts must be torn off and put in wet waste.

wood_ash_from_clean_untreated_wood.name: Wood ash from clean untreated wood

broken_glass_bulb.disposal: Wrap broken bulb glass in paper and put in dry waste.
broken_glass_bulb.safety: Handle with care to avoid cuts.

glass_pane_fragment.disposal: Mirrors, window glass, cookware glass, ceramics and tiles melt at different temperatures from bottle glass and are not accepted with it. Wrap securely and put in dry waste.

glass_wool_scrap.disposal: Mirrors, window glass, cookware glass, ceramics and tiles melt at different temperatures from bottle glass and are not accepted with it. Wrap securely and put in dry waste.
glass_wool_scrap.safety: Wrap sharp pieces in newspaper and label them before disposal.

glass_lampshade.disposal: Mirrors, window glass, cookware glass, ceramics and tiles melt at different temperatures from bottle glass and are not accepted with it. Wrap securely and put in dry waste.

glass_clock_cover.name: Glass clock cover
glass_clock_cover.disposal: Mirrors, window glass, cookware glass, ceramics and tiles melt at different temperatures from bottle glass and are not accepted with it. Wrap securely and put in dry waste.
glass_clock_cover.safety: Wrap sharp pieces in newspaper and label them before disposal.

cfl_bulb.name: CFL bulb
cfl_bulb.disposal: Contains mercury. Do not break it. Hand it to an authorised CFL/lamp collection point or take-back scheme.
cfl_bulb.safety: If it breaks, ventilate the room, do not vacuum, and sweep the pieces into a sealed container.

tube_light.name: Tube light
tube_light.disposal: Contains mercury. Do not break it. Hand it to an authorised lamp collection point.
tube_light.safety: If broken, ventilate the room and avoid touching the powder.

mercury_thermometer.name: Mercury thermometer
mercury_thermometer.disposal: Do not throw in any bin. Put it in a sealed container and give it to a special care waste or biomedical collection point.
mercury_thermometer.safety: Mercury is toxic. Never touch it with bare hands or vacuum it.

syringe.name: Syringe
syringe.disposal: Replace the cap, place it in a rigid puncture-proof container (like a thick plastic bottle) and hand it to a biomedical waste collector or clinic.
syringe.safety: Never recap with two hands, bend, or put loose in a bin; sharps cause injuries and infection.

needle.name: Needle
needle.disposal: Put in a rigid puncture-proof container and hand to a biomedical waste collector or clinic.
needle.safety: Sharps can cause injury and infection.

lancet.name: Lancet
lancet.disposal: Put in a puncture-proof container and hand to a biomedical waste collector or clinic.

insulin_pen.name: Insulin pen
insulin_pen.disposal: Remove the needle into a sharps container and return the pen to a pharmacy or biomedical waste collector.
insulin_pen.safety: Sharps can cause injury and infection.

glucometer_strip.name: Glucometer strip
glucometer_strip.disposal: Place in a sealed bag and give to a biomedical waste collector.

used_bandage.name: Used bandage
used_bandage.disposal: Wrap in paper or a sealed bag and give to a biomedical waste collector. Do not mix with dry or wet waste.

cough_syrup_bottle.name: Cough syrup bottle
cough_syrup_bottle.disposal: Empty or expired liquid medicine goes to a pharmacy take-back or special care waste point. Rinsed empty bottles can go in plastic or glass recycling.

covid_test_kit.name: COVID test kit
covid_test_kit.disposal: Seal in a bag and give to biomedical waste collection.

pesticide_spray.name: Pesticide spray
pesticide_spray.disposal: Take to a special care waste collection point. Do not pour into drains or soil.
pesticide_spray.safety: Toxic to humans, animals and water bodies. Keep away from children.

mosquito_repellent_refill.name: Mosquito repellent refill
mosquito_repellent_refill.disposal: Hand over to special care waste collection when empty or unused.

rat_poison.name: Rat poison
rat_poison.disposal: Special care waste. Hand over to a special care waste collection point.
rat_poison.safety: Highly toxic; keep away from children and pets.

weed_killer.name: Weed killer
weed_killer.disposal: Special care waste. Never pour into soil or drains. Use a special care waste collection point.
weed_killer.safety: Toxic to plants, animals and water.

engine_oil.name: Engine oil
engine_oil.disposal: Collect in a sealed container and give to a garage, authorised used-oil recycler or special care waste point.
engine_oil.safety: One litre of oil can contaminate a million litres of water. Never pour down a drain.

brake_fluid.name: Brake fluid
brake_fluid.disposal: Hand over to a garage or special care waste collection point.

coolant.name: Coolant
coolant.disposal: Collect in a sealed container and take to a garage or special care waste point.
coolant.safety: Sweet-tasting and highly toxic to animals and children.

car_battery.name: Car battery
car_battery.disposal: Return to the dealer or an authorised battery recycler. Most dealers take old batteries when you buy a new one.
car_battery.safety: Contains lead and acid. Never dump or burn it.

button_cell.name: Button cell
button_cell.disposal: Hand over to a battery collection point.
button_cell.safety: Dangerous if swallowed. Keep away from children.

rechargeable_battery.name: Rechargeable battery
rechargeable_battery.disposal: Take to an authorised battery or e-waste collection point.
rechargeable_battery.safety: Swollen or damaged lithium batteries can catch fire; do not crush or puncture.

aa_battery.name: AA battery
aa_battery.disposal: Collect used cells in a container and hand to a battery collection point or e-waste collector.
aa_battery.safety: Never burn batteries or put them in wet waste.

shoe_polish.name: Shoe polish
shoe_polish.disposal: Dry out and hand over to special care waste collection.

paint_thinner.name: Paint thinner
paint_thinner.disposal: Hand over to a special care waste point. Do not pour into drains.

varnish.name: Varnish
varnish.disposal: Dry out small amounts only if the label allows; otherwise special care waste point.
varnish.safety: Flammable; store sealed and away from heat.

spray_paint_can.name: Spray paint can
spray_paint_can.disposal: Use up the can and hand to special care waste collection. Do not puncture or burn.

glue.name: Glue
glue.disposal: Dry out small amounts; otherwise special care waste. Empty tubes go in dry waste.
glue.safety: Fumes can be harmful; keep ventilated.

nail_polish_remover.name: Nail polish remover
nail_polish_remover.disposal: Hand to special care waste collection. Do not pour down the drain.

deodorant_spray_can.name: Deodorant spray can
deodorant_spray_can.disposal: Use it fully; empty cans can go to metal recycling, partly full cans to special care waste.
deodorant_spray_can.safety: Pressurised and flammable. Never puncture or burn.

gas_lighter.name: Gas lighter
gas_lighter.disposal: Use it up, then put in special care waste. Do not throw into fire.

kerosene.name: Kerosene
kerosene.disposal: Store in a sealed container and hand to a fuel station or special care waste collection.
kerosene.safety: Highly flammable. Never pour on the ground or into drains.

toilet_cleaner.name: Toilet cleaner
toilet_cleaner.disposal: Use it up. Leftover or expired cleaner goes to special care waste collection. Rinsed empty bottles go to plastic recycling.
toilet_cleaner.safety: Corrosive. Never mix with bleach; toxic gas can form.

drain_cleaner.name: Drain cleaner
drain_cleaner.disposal: Special care waste. Do not pour into drains.
drain_cleaner.safety: Corrosive and can burn skin and eyes.

phenyl.name: Phenyl
phenyl.disposal: Use up. Leftover chemical goes to special care waste; rinsed empty bottles to plastic recycling.

fire_extinguisher.name: Fire extinguisher
fire_extinguisher.disposal: Return to the supplier or an authorised refiller.

gas_cylinder.name: Gas cylinder
gas_cylinder.disposal: Return to the gas agency. Never dispose in a bin.

smoke_detector.name: Smoke detector
smoke_detector.disposal: Return to the supplier or an e-waste or special care point; some contain radioactive or battery parts.

asbestos_sheet.name: Asbestos sheet
asbestos_sheet.disposal: Do not break or cut. Contact the municipal body or licensed special care waste handler.
asbestos_sheet.safety: Fibres cause serious lung disease. Keep wet and sealed if handling is unavoidable.

ink_bottle.name: Ink bottle
ink_bottle.disposal: Hand to special care waste or an authorised cartridge recycler.

toner_cartridge.name: Toner cartridge
toner_cartridge.disposal: Return to the supplier or an authorised cartridge recycler.
toner_cartridge.safety: Toner powder is a fine dust; do not inhale.

correction_fluid.name: Correction fluid
correction_fluid.disposal: Let it dry out and put in dry waste, or take to special care waste.

mercury_waste.name: Mercury waste
mercury_waste.disposal: Special care waste only. Contact your municipal body or a licensed handler.

empty_paint_can.name: Empty paint can
empty_paint_can.disposal: Only fully dried, empty cans can go to metal recycling. Cans with wet paint are special care waste.

sanitary_waste_of_hospital.name: Hospital / biomedical waste
sanitary_waste_of_hospital.disposal: Must go to licensed biomedical waste handlers in a yellow/red labelled bag.
sanitary_waste_of_hospital.safety: Infectious waste is regulated under Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules.

batteries_from_toys.name: Batteries from toys
batteries_from_toys.disposal: Remove and put with used batteries for collection.
batteries_from_toys.safety: Do not leave batteries inside unused toys; they can leak.

vape.name: Vape
vape.disposal: Contains a lithium battery and nicotine residue. Hand to an authorised e-waste collector.
vape.safety: Do not throw into bins; can catch fire.

tablet.name: Tablet
tablet.disposal: Take it to an authorised e-waste collection point or return it to the brand/retailer take-back scheme.

smartphone.name: Smartphone
smartphone.disposal: Wipe your data first, remove SIM and memory card, then hand to an authorised e-waste collector or exchange scheme.

brass_idol.disposal: Reuse or immerse per local custom; otherwise scrap dealer.

silver_foil_sweet_box.name: Silver foil sweet box
silver_foil_sweet_box.disposal: Rinse or wipe off food, keep it dry and give it to the dry-waste collector or a local scrap dealer.

cigarette_butt.name: Cigarette butt
cigarette_butt.disposal: Put out fully, wrap and put in dry waste. Do not litter; filters are plastic and toxic.
cigarette_butt.safety: Fire risk if not fully put out.

face_mask.name: Face mask
face_mask.disposal: Cut the ear loops, fold into a sealed bag and put in dry waste.
face_mask.safety: Used masks can carry germs; do not litter.

disposable_gloves.name: Disposable gloves
disposable_gloves.disposal: Put in dry waste. Use biomedical collection if contaminated with blood or body fluids.

chewing_gum.name: Chewing gum
chewing_gum.disposal: Wrap in paper and put in dry waste.

tetra_pak_carton.name: Tetra pak carton
tetra_pak_carton.disposal: Empty, rinse, flatten and give to the dry-waste collector. Only some recyclers accept these, so if unavailable put in dry waste.

multilayer_packet.name: Multilayer packet
multilayer_packet.disposal: These are multi-layered plastic that most recyclers cannot process. Keep them dry and put in dry waste (some cities send them to cement kilns).

thermal_receipt.name: Thermal receipt
thermal_receipt.disposal: Thermal paper has a chemical coating and cannot be recycled. General waste.

carbon_paper.name: Carbon paper
carbon_paper.disposal: Coated, laminated or waxed paper cannot be recycled. General waste.

ceramic_plate.name: Ceramic plate
ceramic_plate.disposal: Wrap sharp pieces in newspaper and put in dry waste, or in construction debris if in large quantity.

cat_litter.name: Cat litter
cat_litter.disposal: Bag it and put in dry waste. Do not flush; do not put in compost.

hair.name: Hair
hair.disposal: Put in dry waste. Hair can also be composted in small amounts.

incense_stick.name: Incense stick
incense_stick.disposal: Cool completely and put in dry waste.

foam_mattress.name: Foam mattress
foam_mattress.disposal: Donate if usable; otherwise bulky waste or dry waste.

leather_item.name: Leather item
leather_item.disposal: Donate if usable; otherwise put in dry waste or textile recycling.

old_clothes.name: Old clothes
old_clothes.disposal: Donate wearable clothes; torn textiles can go to textile recycling or dry waste.

bed_linen.name: Bed linen
bed_linen.disposal: Donate if usable; otherwise dry waste or textile recycling.

broken_toy.name: Broken toy
broken_toy.disposal: Donate if usable; broken mixed-material toys go to dry waste.

bricks.name: Bricks
bricks.disposal: Do not mix with household waste. Use the municipal construction and demolition waste collection.

disposable_cutlery.name: Disposable cutlery
disposable_cutlery.disposal: Wooden/bamboo items may be composted if clean; plastic ones go to dry waste.

pencil.name: Pencil
pencil.disposal: Dry pens and markers go to dry waste (some schools run pen-recycling drives).

baby_diaper.name: Baby diaper
baby_diaper.safety: Do not flush; keep away from other recyclables.

sanitary_napkin.name: Sanitary napkin
sanitary_napkin.disposal: Wrap in paper or the pad's own wrapper and keep it with sanitary waste.

razor_blade.name: Razor blade
razor_blade.disposal: Wrap blade in paper or put in a small closed tin so it does not injure waste workers, then dry waste.

soap.name: Soap
soap.disposal: Use up leftovers; empty tubes and jars go to dry waste.

paper_cup.name: Paper cup
paper_cup.disposal: Most paper cups have a thin plastic lining, so they are usually not recyclable. Rinse and put in dry waste, or use a cup-recycling drop point if your city has one.

paper_plate.name: Paper plate
paper_plate.disposal: Food-soiled or coated plates cannot be recycled. Scrape food into wet waste and put the plate in dry waste.

paper_napkin.name: Paper napkin
paper_napkin.disposal: Used napkins are too contaminated to recycle. Put in dry waste, or wet waste if only lightly soiled with food.

toilet_paper.name: Toilet paper
toilet_paper.disposal: Used toilet paper goes in dry waste, wrapped; never flush other items.

sofa.name: Sofa
sofa.disposal: Bulky item: donate or sell to a kabadiwala/second-hand dealer, or request your municipal body's bulky-waste pickup. Do not leave it on the street.

wooden_furniture.name: Wooden furniture
wooden_furniture.disposal: Bulky item: donate or sell to a kabadiwala/second-hand dealer, or request your municipal body's bulky-waste pickup. Do not leave it on the street.

plastic_furniture.name: Plastic furniture
plastic_furniture.disposal: Hard plastic furniture can go to a kabadiwala or plastic scrap dealer.

vehicle_tyre.name: Vehicle tyre
vehicle_tyre.disposal: Give to a tyre dealer or retreader. Never burn tyres.

spectacles.name: Spectacles
spectacles.disposal: Donate usable pairs to an optical charity; otherwise dry waste.

helmet.name: Helmet
helmet.disposal: Replace helmets after any impact. Dispose in dry waste.

umbrella.name: Umbrella
umbrella.disposal: Mixed metal and cloth; give to a scrap dealer or put in dry waste.

stapler.name: Stapler
stapler.disposal: Put in dry waste or give to a scrap dealer.

firecracker_waste.name: Firecracker waste
firecracker_waste.disposal: Soak unburnt crackers in water before disposal. Burnt remains go to dry waste.
firecracker_waste.safety: Never throw unburnt crackers into bins or fires.

rakhi.name: Rakhi
rakhi.disposal: Reuse or donate; otherwise dry waste.

kite_string.name: Kite string
kite_string.disposal: Cut into short pieces before disposal and put in dry waste.
kite_string.safety: Manjha and nylon thread seriously injure birds and people; never leave it hanging.

cooked_snacks.name: Cooked snacks
cooked_snacks.disposal: Put in wet waste or compost. Remove packaging first.

water_filter_cartridge.name: Water filter cartridge
water_filter_cartridge.disposal: Return to the service provider where possible; otherwise dry waste.

playground_equipment.name: Playground equipment
playground_equipment.disposal: Bulky item: contact municipal bulky-waste pickup or a scrap dealer.

paint_brush.name: Paint brush
paint_brush.disposal: Brushes used with water paint go to dry waste. Brushes with oil paint residue go to special care waste.

travel_bag.name: Travel bag
travel_bag.disposal: Donate if usable; otherwise dry waste or textile recycling.

pencil_shavings.name: Pencil shavings
pencil_shavings.disposal: Put in wet waste or compost.

egg_tray.name: Egg tray
egg_tray.disposal: Clean cardboard trays are recyclable; plastic ones go with plastics.

flower_garland.name: Flower garland
flower_garland.disposal: Put in wet waste or compost; avoid dumping in water bodies.

broken_glass_door.name: Broken glass door
broken_glass_door.disposal: Wrap securely and put in dry waste or construction debris.

sofa_cover.name: Cloth cover / uniform
sofa_cover.disposal: Donate if usable; otherwise dry waste.

mobile_cover.name: Mobile cover
mobile_cover.disposal: Hard plastic covers are recyclable; silicone and leather covers go to dry waste.

plastic_scrap.name: Plastic scrap
plastic_scrap.disposal: Dry, clean plastic goes to dry-waste collection or a scrap dealer.

cardboard_waste.name: Cardboard waste
cardboard_waste.disposal: Flatten, keep dry and give to dry-waste collection or kabadiwala.

food_waste.name: Food waste
food_waste.disposal: Put in wet waste or compost.

garden_waste.name: Garden waste
garden_waste.disposal: Compost it or use the municipal green-waste pickup. Do not burn.

glass_waste.name: Glass waste
glass_waste.disposal: Rinse and give to dry-waste or glass collection. Wrap broken pieces in paper.

electronic_scrap.name: Electronic scrap
electronic_scrap.disposal: Take to an authorised e-waste collection point or brand take-back scheme.

medical_waste.name: Medical waste
medical_waste.disposal: Do not mix with household waste. Hand to a biomedical waste collector.

chemical_waste.name: Chemical waste
chemical_waste.disposal: Hand over to a special care waste collection point.
chemical_waste.safety: Keep away from children and never pour down drains.

hair_oil_bottle.name: Hair oil bottle
hair_oil_bottle.disposal: Empty, rinse and put in dry-waste collection.

cooler_box.name: Cooler box
cooler_box.disposal: Hard plastic coolers are recyclable; thermocol ones go to dry waste.
